description: The chart illustrates the number of hateful communication datasets published per year, separated into “Untargeted” and “Targeted” categories. The horizontal axis lists years from 2012 through 2022 in chronological order and is labeled “Year.” The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 up to about 160 with regularly spaced tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Each year is represented by a stacked bar with a legend titled “Targets,” where the lower segment is blue for “Untargeted” and the upper segment is orange for “Targeted.” Approximate stacked totals by year are: 2012 ~2 (orange only), 2013 ~2 (blue only), 2014 ~3 (orange only), 2015 ~3 (orange only), 2016 ~12 (blue ~5 plus orange ~7), 2017 ~28 (blue ~12 plus orange ~16), 2018 ~48 (blue ~20 plus orange ~28), 2019 ~65 (blue ~12 plus orange ~53), 2020 ~130 (blue ~50 plus orange ~80), 2021 ~160 (blue ~65 plus orange ~95), and 2022 ~38 (blue ~10 plus orange ~28). The bars are not visually emphasized with outlines or annotations beyond the color-coded stacking and the legend.
